title: Bhrashtachar
desc: Journalist Bhavani intends to expose and bring to justice a corrupt politician who pretends to be a social worker; however, she soon finds herself trapped in a web of conspiracies.

title: Hum
desc: Enraged by his father's death at the hands of Bakhtawar, Tiger vows to murder him but Inspector Giridhar stops him. Later, Giridhar steals from Bakhtawar and kills his family but blames Tiger for it.

title: Insaf Apne Lahoo Se
desc: Mahendra Pratap marries Geeta, but asks Devilal, her first son, to leave the house. Later, Geeta gets arrested for murder due to her husband's false testimony and gives birth to another son in prison.
